risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed on earnings, net interest trends, liquidity, and credit-loss provisions, but relies materially on management assumptions regarding CECL, collateral values, economic forecasts, securities impairment, and goodwill. Pandemic-related uncertainty and a 124% increase in provision expense indicate elevated credit risk, although profitability, liquidity sources, and goodwill impairment conclusions remain presented positively.
